name: Tianzhou-1
about: Tianzhou-1 (2017-021A), a crewed vehicle (Tianzhou), launched 2017 Apr 20. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DK).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (2017 Apr 21), held fixed
docked to S41765; GCAT's tables give no later phase (undocking, landing)
